linkIntroMeta: SCORED · FOUR FUNCTIONS A BAND 7 ESSAY USES — SPARINGLY
fnConcP: Accept a point, then argue on anyway: despite / in spite of + a noun; nevertheless (formal) or even so (less formal) to open a sentence.
fnEmpP: Strengthen a point you've just made: indeed, in fact, notably.
fnWeiP: Signal your overall judgement: on balance, on the whole, all things considered.
fnSumP: Open the final paragraph: to summarise, in conclusion, overall.
c1Expl: The sentence sets up a contrast (cost rises, ownership still grows), which needs a concession word — "Despite".
c2Expl: This signals a final judgement after weighing both sides — "On balance".
c3Expl: This strengthens a point already under discussion rather than contrasting or exemplifying it — "Indeed".
c4Expl: Another concession structure: an obstacle (cost) that doesn't stop the outcome — "In spite of".
c5Expl: This corrects an assumption with a surprising detail — "in fact".
c6Expl: A clear cause leading to an effect — "consequently".
c7Expl: A one-line verdict opening the final paragraph — "Overall".
c8Expl: A slightly less formal concession connector — "even so" — continues the argument despite the cost.
matchInstr: Click a term on the left, then click its matching description on the right.
match1Expl: All four accept or strengthen a point — notice how much more formal "nevertheless" feels than "even so".
match2Expl: These four finish the set — two intensifiers and two verdict-openers that close out an essay.
chartCtx: The chart below shows recycling rates in two cities from 2010 to 2025.
ch1Expl: City A rises every period (18→27→35→41). City B actually dips between 2015 and 2020.
ch2Expl: City B moves from 34% in 2015 down to 33% in 2020 — a small dip.
ch4Expl: In 2020 the gap is just 2 points (35% vs 33%) — the narrowest of the four years shown.
ch5Expl: City A climbed steadily from 18% to 41%, overtaking City B (which ended at 38%) by 2025.
